description: This file defines an interface AwsClientInterface which specifies the methods that an AWS client implementation must provide. It includes function signatures for command creation, execution (synchronous and asynchronous), retrieving configuration details, and managing paginators and waiters.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for command execution, including async operations via suffixing with 'Async'.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a command object for a specified operation, with optional special transfer options.

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously and returns a promise.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with the credentials object.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region configured for the client.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the default endpoint URI for the client.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the service description object associated with this client.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration option or all options if null.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the list of handlers used to transfer commands.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over a specified operation’s resource.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator for the specified operation.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Blocks until a resource reaches a specified state.

methods.name: getWaiter
methods.description: Returns a waiter object that can wait asynchronously for a resource to reach a state.
